integrity: The proof uses exact contraction, multigraph Laplacian spectra, Kirchhoff’s matrix-tree theorem and a Chebyshev factor identity. Computational checks are bounded corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent external review or certificate is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Counts exact spanning-tree completions of prescribed perfect matchings, not arbitrary prescribed forests. General cycle-type extremal ordering is not established. The overall crown spanning-tree count is previously known. An inaccessible primary article on simple almost-complete graphs and possibly unindexed high-order inclusion formulas remain originality risks.
title: Cycle-type formula for spanning-tree completions of perfect matchings in crown graphs
